optimization_tracks.name: Resident ASR + refiner
optimization_tracks.implementation: Keep one ASR and one optional text model loaded; avoid process and model startup on each turn.
optimization_tracks.measurement: Cold vs warm p50/p95 and RSS; separate first download/JIT.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Native CLI, engine benchmark and paired fresh-process priming

optimization_tracks.name: Continuous audio normalization
optimization_tracks.implementation: Retain native-rate state and normalize once per ASR path to float32 16 kHz. Native quality stays unchanged after five-setting tradeoff study.
optimization_tracks.measurement: Exact PCM/tails, amplitude/alias response, WER/CER, first-output input position and packet cost.
optimization_tracks.evidence: 335 Swift tests; 870 native replay requests, 1,500 file ASR requests and 50 streams; no alternative passes every gate

optimization_tracks.name: In-memory Parakeet front end
optimization_tracks.implementation: Short utterances bypass temporary WAV encoding and FFmpeg spawning.

optimization_tracks.name: Precision by stage
optimization_tracks.implementation: Float32 acoustic front end; bfloat16 Parakeet weights, fp16 Whisper, quantized Qwen/Nemotron.
optimization_tracks.measurement: WER/CER, p95 and actual peak memory; reject silent drift.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Quantized model runs; dtype ablation remains

optimization_tracks.name: No unnecessary second model
optimization_tracks.implementation: Deterministic fillers/snippets by default; AI refinement is explicit.
optimization_tracks.measurement: End-to-end latency and factual preservation with/without rewriting.

optimization_tracks.name: Conservative endpointing
optimization_tracks.implementation: Full audio by default; optional RMS/neural edges and auto finish. Empty results retain completed audio for retry.
optimization_tracks.measurement: Quiet speech deletion, silence hallucination, tail-cut rate and 150/300/500ms endpoint sweeps.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Quiet/multilingual controls reject neural defaults; physical endpoint sweep pending

optimization_tracks.name: Bound capture and preview work
optimization_tracks.implementation: Preallocated asynchronous disk buffers, reusable mono scratch, 10 Hz UI telemetry, fixed 12s ring, one preview in flight.
optimization_tracks.measurement: Dropped frames, render callback p99, preview contention and memory ceiling.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Native frame/overflow tests; device profiling pending

optimization_tracks.name: Chunked stdio and cancellation
optimization_tracks.implementation: Buffered JSON replies, serial queue, request generations, watchdog and child recovery.
optimization_tracks.measurement: IPC round trip, 30-way admission, timeout/restart and stale-output rate.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Native IPC tests; no local server

optimization_tracks.name: True cached streaming
optimization_tracks.implementation: Nemotron incremental session avoids repeatedly decoding a growing prefix.
optimization_tracks.measurement: 320ms packet replay, first partial, stable-prefix revisions, final tail, WER vs offline.

optimization_tracks.name: Prime kernels before recording
optimization_tracks.implementation: Explicit model loading decodes a one-second 48 kHz synthetic tone and discards the result, preparing resampling and first-use kernels before the next real turn.
optimization_tracks.measurement: Three paired fresh processes per model; compare first-real latency, preparation cost and identical outputs. Work is shifted, not removed.
optimization_tracks.evidence: Fresh-process warmup harness; 16/48 kHz controls and six-engine packaged preparation
